## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the [Coding Standards](https://github.com/qyne-tech/.github/blob/main/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] CI green — format, lint, typecheck, test, build
- [ ] Tests added/updated (a bug fix has a failing-then-passing test)
- [ ] No secrets or PII in code, logs, or fixtures
- [ ] Docs current — README, and backend OpenAPI/Swagger — updated or "no change needed"
- [ ] Conventional-commit title; branch off `develop`; **not** self-merged (maintainer merges)
